races.name: Virgin Bet Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Swing Vote
runners_data.note: Holds Goodwood course form well, including a win here over this exact mile trip, and William Buick's booking is significant; tongue-tie fitted and soft ground is fine — the prominent style is perfectly suited to sitting just off Masked Warrior's sustainable lead.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Swing Vote nonetheless tops our ratings, if only narrowly, and has experience over today's trip, giving him an obvious chance from stall five at 143 lb — the main concern is his uninspiring recent form and a 74-day absence to overcome.

runners_data.name: Godwinson
runners_data.note: Consistent soft-ground performer who has run exclusively over this course and distance in recent outings, but a string of double-figure finishes at Goodwood raises serious questions about his ability to land a blow even from his natural hold-up position.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Godwinson nevertheless catches the eye rated 100 by our assessors — four pounds clear of his official mark — and he has run over today's trip and going before, while 30 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh; the risk is that recent form offers no encouragement.

runners_data.name: Principality
runners_data.note: Won over this course and distance last time out and has placed on soft ground previously — trainer Harry Eustace in good form (T14: 3/16) and apprentice Kaiya Fraser claims; hold-up style needs the pace to be honest enough to bring closers into play.
runners_data.comment: Principality won last time out and has run over today's trip, but his record in recent starts also features a couple of fifths and an unplaced effort, suggesting inconsistency that makes him harder to trust, even if 16 days between runs leaves him fresh enough.

runners_data.name: Real Gain
runners_data.note: Wears a hood and races prominently, with course form at Goodwood over this trip; Harry Vigors claims 5lb which helps the burden, but recent form figures of 00-458 don't inspire confidence and Goodwood soft-ground record is modest.
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in his last five starts, Real Gain arrives here 29 days fresh, with experience of today's trip and going in his favour, and a speed rating of 91 that suggests more ability than his recent finishes — carrying 136 lb from stall 10 — imply.

runners_data.name: Oliver Show
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie and cheek-pieces engaged, and Billy Loughnane takes the ride for the in-form George Boughey yard; has run well at Goodwood over shorter trips but stepping back up to a mile on soft ground is a query given recent form has been middling.
runners_data.comment: Oliver Show arrives here 32 days on from his latest outing, and a rating of 100 highlights him as a serious threat, third-best on our figures; he has run over today's trip and carries 136 lb from stall six, though his recent winless run is the primary concern.

runners_data.name: Rhoscolyn
runners_data.note: Ran just yesterday (LR: 1d) which is a significant fitness and freshness concern over a testing mile on soft ground; Daniel Tudhope is a smart jockey but the hold-up style and quick turnaround make this a difficult assignment, and he has a tendency to fade late.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts and running again just a day after his latest eighth, Rhoscolyn faces a stiff ask here, though he has run over today's trip and going before and our rating of 92 suggests some unexploited potential at a mark of 84.

runners_data.name: Rainbow Nebula
runners_data.note: Has been running over ten furlongs recently, so dropping back to a mile is a distance query; races as a hold-up type by nature but the crowded rear section means he may not get the rail position he needs — soft-ground form is acceptable but the step back in trip is the headline issue.
runners_data.comment: Rainbow Nebula has run over today's trip and comes here fresh on a quick eight-day turnaround carrying 130 lb from stall two, but back-to-back unplaced efforts cloud his recent form, with his sole win coming six starts back.

runners_data.name: Masked Warrior
runners_data.note: The sole front-runner in the field, which gives Cieren Fallon complete control of the tempo; has placed three times on soft going and won over seven furlongs at Sandown — stepping up in competitive company but the tactical advantage of unopposed lead is real.
runners_data.comment: Ranked eighth of ten on our figures, Masked Warrior is hard to fancy despite a win three starts back and a third two starts back, and his speed rating of 80 leaves him well below the principals; the distance and going experience at least ensures no unknowns on those fronts.

runners_data.name: Drifts Away
runners_data.note: Boasts two wins over this exact course and distance (Goodwood, 8f) and the stable (T J Kent, T14: 1/5) is quietly operating; prominent style from a good draw suits sitting just behind the leader, and course specialists at Goodwood must always be respected.

runners_data.name: Silca Bay
runners_data.note: A natural prominent racer who has won twice over this course and distance, but with several others also wanting to race handy there simply isn't room — Oliver Carmichael's 7lb claim helps, yet being squeezed out of position in a crowded midfield reduces his chance materially.
runners_data.comment: Silca Bay ran fifth last time out and, ranked bottom of the field on our figures, he is hard to fancy despite two wins in his last six starts; he has run over today's trip and returns after 25 days, but the form profile makes him a difficult proposition at these weights.

runners_data.name: Inspired
runners_data.note: Boasts a fine recent record including two wins over this exact course and distance, and K.R. Burke's yard is firing (T14: 9/44); a genuine handy-type horse who is likely to find himself racing further back than ideal given the congestion up front — Clifford Lee will need to be patient.
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom but one on our figures and up against nine rivals, Inspired makes his case on a fair recent run of form — a winner two starts back and runner-up last time out — and has run over today's trip, though the weight of 127 lb adds to his task.

races.paceDynamic: Masked Warrior is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with no horse likely to seriously challenge for the lead in the early stages, Cieren Fallon can dictate a controlled, measured tempo on soft ground over this mile at Goodwood. The pace will be sustainable rather than scorching, meaning Masked Warrior can potentially save enough petrol to extend his advantage through the home straight rather than being run down by closers. Swing Vote, Real Gain, Oliver Show, and Drifts Away will track up in the prominent positions behind, creating a compact early order, while Principality, Godwinson, and Rhoscolyn will need to work from further back. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit just off a comfortable lead and produce a sustained gallop on the testing ground — pure hold-up horses face a stiffer task unless the pace truly collapses late. The field contains more prominent and hold-up types than can secure their natural position; Silca Bay and Inspired are genuine prominent horses who are likely to be pushed wider in the pack, with Swing Vote, Real Gain, and Oliver Show best-placed to occupy those vital tracking spots behind Masked Warrior.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Masked Warrior Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Masked Warrior is allowed a soft, uncontested lead and the pace remains measured on the soft ground.
scenarios.body: Fallon sets an economical gallop that never gets truly punishing, allowing Masked Warrior to find extra in the straight having conserved energy through the race; the soft ground rewards a horse who has travelled kindly rather than those grinding from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Stalkers Overhaul Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers travelling behind Masked Warrior move smoothly into contention turning in and outfinish him in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The combination of soft going and a mile slightly stretching Masked Warrior sees the stalking horses, having been saved by the controlled tempo, pick off the leader inside the final 150 yards; this suits horses with proven Goodwood course form who track up efficiently.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sweeps Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is just quick enough to string the field out and the genuine closers find the gaps they need in the straight.
scenarios.body: Principality or Godwinson, both with soft-ground course form, motor through beaten horses inside the final two furlongs as the early tempo takes a toll on those prominent; this requires everything to go right positionally in a field where true hold-up ground is crowded.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Masked Warrior sets an overly slow pace that results in a sprint finish from a large group on testing ground.
scenarios.body: A falsely-run race on soft going produces a wall of tired horses in the straight with the result coming down to individual luck in running; redistributed types like Silca Bay or Inspired who couldn't get their natural position may benefit from a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Drifts Away has won twice over Goodwood's mile and races prominently — if he slots in directly behind Masked Warrior he becomes the most dangerous horse in the race given his course and distance affinity.

Rhoscolyn ran yesterday and faces a soft-ground mile just 24 hours later — watch for any signs of distress in the paddock or a laboured early effort that confirms the quick turnaround has left its mark.

Silca Bay and Inspired both want to race prominently but will struggle to get that position — if either is forced wide or dwells at the start it materially reduces what are already compromised chances.

Masked Warrior's early sectionals are key: if Fallon allows the pace to drift very slow, the race opens up for a sprint finish that could hand an advantage to horses with redistributed positions who benefit from a bunched outcome.

Principality won over this course and distance last time and the trainer is in form — Kaiya Fraser's claim brings the weight down, and on softer going a hold-up run can succeed if Masked Warrior's lead is pegged back turning in.

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Ferrous
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who loves Goodwood's 6f, placed here twice in similar company; soft going is fine but Callum Rodriguez must find a clean passage in a 15-runner field and the horse's two wins on soft came with luck in running.
runners_data.comment: Ferrous ran second two starts back and brings strong credentials into this, his experience over today's trip and going an asset at 138 lb from stall ten, with our rating of 106 marking him out as a leading threat; the risk is that he has been winless in his last six starts.

runners_data.name: Fandom
runners_data.note: Richard Hannon's prominent racer has course form at this trip but his last 14 runners have yielded zero wins; Goodwood 6f is his track but finishing positions suggest he finds one or two too good rather than winning.
runners_data.comment: Fandom arrives on the back of a third last time out, showing he retains ability, but the trainer's dismal 2% strike-rate over the past fortnight is a real concern; he has experience over today's trip and a win in recent starts, yet 136 lb from stall 14 adds further questions.

runners_data.name: Ardisia
runners_data.note: The race's confirmed pace-setter who carries a STYLE_FIT flag — she is being asked to front-run here when her recent form shows her racing more off the pace; Hugo Palmer's 3-year-old has solid soft-going form but the lone front-runner role may flatter her in the early splits before exposing her in the finish.
runners_data.comment: Ardisia has run over today's trip and going, and a third three starts back highlights he is capable of mixing it at this level; at 135 lb from stall 13, the weight burden is the chief concern for a gelding yet to score in his last six.

runners_data.name: Toyotomi
runners_data.note: Won over course and distance on soft going (2nd June) and David O'Meara's 5-year-old is a proven hold-up performer whose best Goodwood form has come when allowed to settle and pick up; 71 days off is a minor query but going and trip are ideal.
runners_data.comment: Toyotomi was a winner two starts back and third three starts back, but he disappointed on his latest outing 71 days ago, making fitness a query; he has run over today's distance and going before, and 133 lb from stall five keeps him interesting if sharper here.

runners_data.name: Lakers
runners_data.note: Kevin Philippart De Foy's 4-year-old won a 6f Sandown handicap and has placed three times over 6f on good-to-soft or softer; 135 days off is the biggest concern, and David Egan will need him tuned up first time back.
runners_data.comment: Lakers showed promise with thirds three and four starts back, and a win five starts back, but his last two runs have been disappointing, and 135 days off the track is a fitness concern; experience over today's trip and going at least counts in his favour.

runners_data.name: Fast Track Harry
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for Clive Cox who ran well for second over course and distance but his last six outings at Goodwood include no wins; headgear (tongue-tie and p) applied, and 15 days since last run suggests he is in a good spell though soft ground is not his very best.
runners_data.comment: Fast Track Harry showed his best when finishing second two starts back, but he has been winless in his last six starts and that unplaced effort last time out is a concern; he has run over today's distance and going, and 15 days between runs suggests he is fit enough to go again from stall eight off 133 lb.

runners_data.name: Flash Harry
runners_data.note: Stablemate of Fast Track Harry and another who wants to race prominently; two soft-ground runs at Goodwood both ended in double-figure finishes, and the going record at the course is the clearest negative in the book.
runners_data.comment: Flash Harry has run over today's trip and going, and with a speed rating of 95 underpinning a strong case at 133 lb from stall two, he shapes as a genuine threat eight days fresh; the concern is a winless recent run of five starts.

runners_data.name: Purosangue
runners_data.note: Robert Cowell's 5-year-old is a genuine hold-up type who has placed four times but never won at Goodwood; 6f on soft is workable but he needs a stronger pace than Ardisia alone is likely to generate to produce his best finish.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Purosangue nonetheless rates top of the field on our figures and has experience of both today's trip and going; he returns 29 days after his latest outing, and off 132 lb from stall nine, he is the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Havana Hurricane
runners_data.note: Eve Johnson Houghton's 3-year-old carries headgear (p) and has a 3rd on soft at Goodwood over 5f on his card; he is a hold-up performer who needs to step forward from an 8th at this course last time, and the longer 6f is a slight unknown.
runners_data.comment: Havana Hurricane has been winless in his last five starts, with back-to-back disappointing eighths and ninths, though a third three starts back suggests ability remains; the experience over today's trip and a rating of 101 offer faint encouragement from stall seven.

runners_data.name: Strike Red
runners_data.note: Won this course and distance and finished 2nd at Catterick over 6f on soft; Richard & Peter Fahey's 8-year-old is a lively pace-prominent type with the strongest soft-and-course combination in the field, though 44 days off and top weight for an 8-year-old demand respect rather than blind faith.
runners_data.comment: Strike Red arrives on the back of a win and a second in his last two starts, which reads well, but ranked 11 of 15 on our figures he faces a stiff ask off 130 lb from stall six, and 44 days off adds mild uncertainty.

runners_data.name: Rapper's Delight
runners_data.note: In reality a front-running or prominent type who has been pushed to midfield on the map because the field is congested near the pace; George Wood's mount carries a visor and has two 2nd-place finishes at 5f on soft, but being unable to stride on from his natural position blunts his chance materially.
runners_data.comment: Rapper's Delight has shown consistent placed ability in recent starts, with a second two starts back and a second three starts back, yet he's winless in his last six and that disappointing eighth last time out is a concern; the distance experience and 33-day break offer some encouragement from stall 15 off 128 lb.

runners_data.name: Jungle Drums
runners_data.note: Jamie Osborne's 4-year-old won over 6f at Sandown on soft and is a genuine hold-up horse by nature, though crowding at the rear has pushed him onto the map closer to midfield than he will race in reality; good soft-going form is the headline positive, and a clear run is essential.
runners_data.comment: Ranked well down the field on our figures and drawn in stall 12, Jungle Drums is hard to fancy despite a win two starts back and the experience of today's trip and conditions; fourth last time out and a rating of 91 leaves him with plenty to prove against this field.

runners_data.name: Sudden Flight
runners_data.note: Richard Hughes runner who genuinely wants to race prominently — his three 2nd-place finishes at Goodwood came when tracking the pace — but with so many runners seeking the same positions he is likely to find himself further back than ideal, which is a material disadvantage to his style.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts despite three runner-up finishes and a third in that sequence, Sudden Flight ranks 12th of 15 on our figures and looks hard to fancy, though he has run over today's trip and going before and returns on a fresh enough 20-day break.

runners_data.name: Zoulu Chief
runners_data.note: Ran yesterday (1 day since last run) which is an immediate flag; Heather Main's 5-year-old has struggled at Goodwood in recent starts and soft form figures are modest, with the ultra-quick back-to-back scheduling the dominant concern regardless of going suitability.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, with back-to-back ninths and an eighth last time out just one day ago, Zoulu Chief arrives here underprepared on the freshness front and ranks last on our figures, making him very hard to fancy despite having run over today's trip.

runners_data.name: Purest Time
runners_data.note: Ian Williams's 6-year-old is a true hold-up horse who won over this course and distance but that was over a year ago; the recent string shows he has gone 0 from 15 on soft and his last six form figures at Goodwood are uninspiring.
runners_data.comment: Ranked 14 of 15 on our figures, Purest Time makes little appeal after three successive failures to land a blow, including two unplaced efforts in his last three starts, though he has run over today's distance and going before and draws stall one.

races.paceDynamic: Ardisia is the one confirmed front-runner here, and on soft ground at Goodwood she is likely to bowl along at a measured, sustainable tempo rather than being torched into the ground — she sets the terms without being seriously pressured from the off. Strike Red and Fandom will want to race prominently and may push into the first two or three positions, but the pace is unlikely to be truly searching given it is one horse doing the lion's share of the donkey work. That controlled, moderate-to-fair gallop on a soft surface strongly favours horses who can sit just behind the pace and deliver a sustained finish — prominent-to-midfield closers who can travel into the race without burning energy fighting for position are the primary beneficiaries. This field contains significantly more front-running and prominent types than can all find their natural position: Rapper's Delight, Sudden Flight, Fast Track Harry and Flash Harry all want to race close to the pace but are likely to be shuffled back from their natural spots, with Strike Red and Fandom best placed to secure the genuine prominent berths behind Ardisia.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ardisia Controls, Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Ardisia leads as expected at a controlled soft-ground tempo and no rival applies sustained early pressure.
scenarios.body: Ardisia rolls along at a gallop that flatters those just off the pace, and the lack of true cut-and-thrust early means energy is preserved for the final two furlongs; horses able to sit two to four lengths off and quicken on the testing ground have a decisive edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace War Burns Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Fandom, Strike Red or a displaced prominent type forces a genuine pace duel with Ardisia through the first half.
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes genuinely hot for soft conditions, the front rank ties up inside the final furlong, and horses who have been able to coast in midfield with cover find the stamina reserves to reel them in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Slog, Front Two Hold
scenarios.trigger: If the ground deteriorates further during the afternoon and Ardisia's controlled fractions prove ideal for a staying effort at the sharp end.
scenarios.body: The race turns into an attritional grind where the runner setting her own pace and those directly behind her benefit most from not having to make up ground through deep ground; hold-up horses simply cannot generate the momentum to close.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Threads Through
scenarios.trigger: If a midfield or redistributed runner finds a dream run through the pack in the final furlong and benefits from rivals being blocked or checked.
scenarios.body: In a 15-runner race on a soft surface, traffic can hold up late closers while one horse finds daylight at the critical moment; a horse like Jungle Drums or Sudden Flight, racing out of their natural role but possessing raw pace, catches the eye if the run materialises cleanly.

watchPoints.text: Zoulu Chief ran just one day ago — watch the market closely; if he drifts sharply in the ring it confirms connections are managing him rather than expecting a big run, and any market support would be a significant flag given the brutal turnaround.

Strike Red's soft-ground course-and-distance win is the standout stat in the field — if he forces his way into a prominent position behind Ardisia early and travels sweetly into the final two furlongs, he becomes the most dangerous single threat.

Monitor how many of the displaced prominent types — particularly Rapper's Delight and Sudden Flight — actually manage to stride up in the early stages; if two or three force a pace battle with Ardisia, the scenario changes dramatically from a controlled tempo to a genuine burn-up.

Lakers has not run for 135 days and comes from a trainer operating at 3/14 over the past fortnight; watch the paddock and early price movement — a well-oiled appearance would substantially upgrade his chances given his solid form on this ground and trip.

Goodwood's unique downhill-then-uphill 6f configuration rewards horses who switch off in the first half; on soft ground the premium on relaxed early running is even higher, so watch for any horse fighting for its head or missing the break — either could be decisive.

races.name: Virgin Bet Prestige Fillies' Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Aperoll
runners_data.note: Proven Goodwood front-runner for Hannon/Dobbs with wins at this course over six and seven furlongs, OR 95 suggests she will struggle if Coaxed controls from the front, and soft ground here has been no issue in her three runs; 38 days off is not a concern given that profile.|
runners_data.comment: Aperoll arrives on the back of two wins in her last three starts, and her experience over today's trip is a further asset; the 38-day absence is the one question mark connections must answer.

runners_data.name: Apollo's Comet
runners_data.note: Highest-rated horse in the field at OR 120 and has placed at Group level over this course and trip; Billy Loughnane rides for Mrs Harrington who has a live 14-day record, and 73 days since last run is the one query, though the form figures of 3-1 at Goodwood over seven furlongs give confidence she handles this test.|
runners_data.comment: Apollo's Comet won last time out but her speed rating of 64 leaves her with a bit to find on our figures, ranked seventh of nine, and a 73-day absence adds further uncertainty, though she has run over today's trip and draws stall five.

runners_data.name: Bayside View
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy partners a horse with strong Goodwood form including a course win over seven furlongs, and Bell's 14-day strike rate of 2/17 is respectable; her style is naturally front-running and she will contest the early lead with Coaxed and Aperoll, meaning traffic and energy expenditure are the chief dangers.|
runners_data.comment: Bayside View arrives on the back of a fine run of form — second last time out, a winner two starts back, and second three starts back — and has experience over today's trip, though 38 days off the track is the one query connections must answer.

runners_data.name: Coaxed
runners_data.note: William Buick for Gosden on a debutant winner who impressed at Sandown — Gosden's 6/25 14-day record is strong and Buick's positional management makes her the most likely to actually control the pace rather than fight for it; the single run in her history is the only uncertainty but the class profile is clear.|
runners_data.comment: Rated well below the top-ranked runners on these figures, Coaxed won last time out and has run over today's trip, but she has plenty to find on these figures with her rating of 85 ranking her eighth of nine, making her hard to fancy at face value.

runners_data.name: Eabha
runners_data.note: Eve Johnson Houghton's filly has back-to-back Goodwin wins over seven furlongs and arrives just 15 days since her last run in good form; her record in similar soft conditions is limited (1 from 5 in soft-adjacent going) but she handles Goodwood well and Charles Bishop's course knowledge is an asset.|
runners_data.comment: Placed third last time out, though a winner two and three starts back shows she retains the ability; has run over today's trip and returns on a quick turnaround of 15 days, but at 128 lb from stall six, the weight ask may test her claims.

runners_data.name: Light Of Dawn
runners_data.note: K.R. Burke's filly has won on soft ground and her 14-day record of 9/44 is volume-heavy; she steps up from six furlongs where she has won and placed on soft, and two from three on similar going makes her a genuine soft-ground player if she sees out the extra furlong, which is the key question.|
runners_data.comment: Light Of Dawn arrives on the back of two consecutive thirds following a win three starts back, and with experience over today's trip and going she looks a genuine threat; the 128 lb burden from stall ten is the chief concern.

runners_data.name: Martinet
runners_data.note: Sir Mark Prescott's runner has placed twice at Goodwood over seven furlongs including a win at this course, and a front-running style means she will compete for the early lead with at least four rivals; Luke Morris rides and the 22-day turnaround suits Prescott's yard which typically has runners fit.|

runners_data.name: Nuit d'Eclair
runners_data.note: David Egan partners a filly who has placed twice at Goodwood over seven furlongs and won over six here; Kevin Philippart De Foy's 14-day record is modest at 3/14 but the horse's form figures of 1-4-2 show a consistent performer who handles this course, and a prominent-holding style sits ideally in the second tier behind the pace battle.|
runners_data.comment: Nuit d'Eclair shaped with plenty of promise when second last time out, and a winner three starts back, she brings strong claims on that recent form, having run over today's trip before and arriving here fresh on 22 days' rest carrying 128 lb from stall three.

runners_data.name: Redline
runners_data.note: Two wins from two for Charlie Johnston's filly, both at Goodwood, gives her undeniable course form; Johnston's 14-day rate of 4/38 is decent, but 55 days off combined with stepping into Group company for the first time against higher-rated rivals makes this a significant ask even if the course form is eye-catching.|
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of nine on our figures and her speed rating of 67 has plenty to find, making her hard to fancy on ratings alone, though back-to-back wins and experience over today's trip offer genuine encouragement after 55 days off.

runners_data.name: Siena Storm
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's runner has a Goodwood maiden win over a mile suggesting stamina is her strong suit; dropping back to seven furlongs may not be ideal and a hold-up style means she needs a strong pace and a clear run through traffic that is far from guaranteed in this congested field — 17 days since last run is fine.|
runners_data.comment: Siena Storm arrives here on the back of a win last time out and has run over today's trip before, but a fourth two starts back shows she can find one or two too good, and carrying 128 lb from stall eight adds pressure on a mid-table rating of 83.

races.paceDynamic: Five declared front-runners — Coaxed, Aperoll, Bayside View, Martinet, and Redline — guarantee an aggressive early tempo over seven furlongs of soft Goodwood, a combination that historically burns off the field before the home turn and turns this into a true stamina test. Coaxed (William Buick, Gosden) is the class act among the pace brigade and will likely dictate from the front, while Aperoll and Bayside View are proven Goodwood front-runners who will press hard and compress the early splits even further. Martinet and Redline complete a congested pace picture; with five horses seeking the rail in soft ground, traffic friction and early crowding between the two-furlong pole and the three-furlong marker is almost certain, creating a physical and tactical hazard that could fatally compromise several runners. The field holds more front-running types than can all find clean positions, and Coaxed and Bayside View are most likely to actually secure the lead given class and jockey quality — this race shape emphatically favours prominent-to-lead runners with proven soft-ground stamina, provided they avoid the early scrimmaging, and penalises hold-up horses who will face traffic and a pace-ravaged strip of ground to close onto.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Coaxed Dominates From Front
scenarios.trigger: If Coaxed breaks cleanly and Buick allows her to control the pace, she dictates the gallop and kicks decisively turning in.
scenarios.body: Coaxed's single run at Sandown showed a professional front-running display, and Buick's positional discipline means she avoids the early scrimmaging that could ensnare rivals Aperoll and Bayside View; on soft ground at Goodwood the premium is on a horse who can control energy output from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Stamina Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the front-running quintet burns each other out through the first four furlongs, the race falls apart and a prominent stalker swoops late.
scenarios.body: Apollo's Comet, proven at Group level on this course, and Nuit d'Eclair, who has winning form at Goodwood and soft going, are ideally placed just off the carnage to pick up the pieces as the pace horses tie up; on testing ground seven furlongs at Goodwood has historically exposed any horse that burns energy fighting for position early, and these two have the class and freshness to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Specialist Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace genuinely ends the race for the front-runners and the winner emerges from midfield on the far rail where the better ground sits.
scenarios.body: Light Of Dawn arrives with two wins on soft or good-to-soft going over six furlongs and steps up in trip having shown high cruising speed; Eabha has back-to-back Goodwood wins and proven seven-furlong form on this course but will need a trouble-free passage through what promises to be congested midfield traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Finish Late
scenarios.trigger: If the field fans wide in the home straight and hold-up runners find a clear passage along the outside late.
scenarios.body: Siena Storm has winning form at Goodwood over a mile on this course and drops back in trip, offering raw stamina but requiring a truly strong pace to have any chance of pegging back the field; this scenario depends on the pace being extreme and the gaps opening early enough in the home straight, both low-probability conditions given that a Buick-ridden class horse at the front is likely to control the tempo rather than truly set a suicidal pace.

watchPoints.text: Coaxed and Bayside View are both confirmed front-runners seeking the same position from stall 4 and 3 respectively — watch for early crowding and bumping in the first furlong that could compromise either or both.

Apollo's Comet has been off 73 days and enters Group 3 company on soft ground at Goodwood; if she has lost any sharpness during the absence, her chance evaporates quickly in a strongly-run race that may not suit a rusty horse.

Redline's unbeaten Goodwood record is compelling but 55 days off and a significant class jump into Group 3 company means she is vulnerable if her rivals are sharper — watch her price if there is any drift.

Siena Storm needs the pace to be truly extreme to produce a late run from a hold-up position in soft ground at Goodwood over seven furlongs — if Coaxed controls the tempo and takes the sting out of the fractions, this runner has almost no scenario that suits her.

Light Of Dawn's six-to-seven furlong trip extension is the tactical pivot in her scenario — watch how Clifford Lee positions her in the first three furlongs; if she is covered up tightly in midfield behind the scrimmage, she may not find clear air until too late.|

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Selling Stakes

runners_data.name: Echalar
runners_data.note: Recent Goodwood winner over 10f (1/10f/GOO) is the key form hook, but his natural hold-up style is compromised here — the field is too full of closers for him to find clear daylight from the rear, so he is mapped to midfield and his chance is tempered by having to race out of role.|
runners_data.comment: Echalar won last time out to arrive in decent nick, and he has run over today's trip and going before, but our rating of 72 leaves him ranked sixth of eight and he carries 139 lb from stall two, making this a tough ask.

runners_data.name: Gloryous
runners_data.note: One of two confirmed pace-setters, ran 4 days ago which is tight but Jamie Osborne's yard fires horses back quickly (2 from 11 in 14 days); recent form includes a Goodwood placed effort and a Sandown win, and she handles soft fine — her chief risk is Itica taking her on from the off.|
runners_data.comment: Gloryous arrives on the back of a win last time out, and her experience over today's trip and going bolsters her claims as the top-rated runner in this field; the chief concern is whether four days is enough recovery time carrying 134 lb.

runners_data.name: Lorca's Waltz
runners_data.note: William Haggas runner stepping up significantly in trip from recent 8f runs, and his sole soft-ground start yielded an 11th — the going is a potential query, but tongue-tie fitted and the trip extension to 1m3f could unlock improvement; 20 days since last run is a normal preparation.|
runners_data.comment: Lorca's Waltz finds himself rated well below his official mark on our figures and ranks towards the foot of this field, making him genuinely hard to fancy; he has run over today's trip and returns after 20 days, but a win in his last five starts is the lone crumb of comfort.

runners_data.name: Ohara
runners_data.note: Two placed efforts at Goodwood over 12f including a win suggest the course and trip suit, but she is a genuine hold-up horse squeezed into midfield by the sheer volume of closers in this field — her style fit is marginally discounted and an apprentice claiming 7lb on Oliver Carmichael is a potential positive on weight.|
runners_data.comment: Ohara shaped well for a second three starts back and brings distance-and-going experience to this assignment, with a lively rating of 77 supporting his claims; the concern is that he has been winless in recent starts and a seventh last time out leaves plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Sudbury Hill
runners_data.note: Callum Rodriguez partner has an excellent Goodwood profile — two wins at the track over 10f-17f in the last five runs — and has shown he stays well in soft-adjacent conditions; his hold-up style is natural but the midfield mapping here is his genuine position given the traffic, making him one of the better-placed closers.|
runners_data.comment: Sudbury Hill brings a lively profile to this, placed five times in his last six starts with a win two starts back and a second last time out, suggesting he is in fine heart after a 17-day break. He has run over today's trip before, and 131 lb from stall seven are the key conditions to assess.

runners_data.name: Unchartedterritory
runners_data.note: Ran just 1 day ago which is an extreme turnaround and must be flagged as a concern; soft-ground form is solid (1W2P in 3 starts) and he stays 12f, but like Echalar and Ohara he is a true hold-up horse forced into midfield, and the ultra-quick reappearance makes his chance speculative.|
runners_data.comment: Unchartedterritory showed up well with a second last time out and has experience of today's trip and conditions, but he runs just one day after that effort and his speed figure of 69 gives the opposition something to work with from stall five carrying 131 lb.

runners_data.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners_data.note: K.R. Burke's operation is in excellent form (9 from 44 in 14 days), and Dunkeld Dreamer's prominent style is perfectly suited to sitting just off the two front-runners; a Goodwood win over 12f and placed efforts on soft ground make him one of the best-fitting profiles for the likely race shape.|
runners_data.comment: Dunkeld Dreamer won three starts back and has experience of today's trip and conditions, carrying 130 lb from stall one; the concern is that unplaced effort last time out leaves her needing to bounce back sharply.

runners_data.name: Itica
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy is a key booking for Andrew Balding and will ensure Itica doesn't surrender the lead without a fight — however, all five career runs have been over 8f, so the step to 1m3f on soft ground is a significant unknown; if she ties up after setting the pace, she may fall away sharply in the straight.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts and ranked bottom on our figures, Itica faces a stiff task here; a second three starts back offers a slim crumb of encouragement, but 128 lb and an official rating of 71 make this a tough assignment.

races.paceDynamic: Gloryous and Itica are the two confirmed front-runners, and with Oisin Murphy aboard Itica there will be no gift of an easy lead — both will contest the early fractions, meaning the pace in soft ground over 1m3f at Goodwood is likely to be honest to strong rather than falsely slow. That sustained gallop through testing conditions will stretch the field on the long Goodwood straight, placing a premium on stamina and the ability to travel powerfully into the race rather than making an abrupt late challenge. The field holds more hold-up types than the map can accommodate at the rear — Echalar, Ohara, and Unchartedterritory are true closers redistributed to midfield, meaning Gloryous and Dunkeld Dreamer are best placed to actually secure their natural prominent positions. This race shape strongly favours prominent and mid-division types who can sit close to the contested pace, travel through the soft ground efficiently, and produce a sustained rather than a sharp finish — genuine late closers launching from far back face a reduced chance given the overcrowding at the rear end of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Gloryous and Itica fight for the lead and set a genuine soft-ground gallop, horses positioned close to that battle without being burned off will hold the decisive advantage.
scenarios.body: The two leaders trade fractions through the first mile, softening each other up and leaving the door open for a prominent tracker to sweep past in the Goodwood straight; soft ground rewards those who have conserved energy by travelling close to the pace rather than chasing from distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gloryous uses Carson's positional nous to dictate a controlled but testing gallop and Itica cannot match that early pace without over-racing.
scenarios.body: Gloryous gets a rhythm in front on terms she dictates, the field strings out in the soft, and her recent Goodwood form — including a win at Sandown and placed effort at Goodwood itself — proves she stays 1m3f in this going better than her rivals can close.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Grind, Stamina Decides
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard early and tie up inside the final two furlongs, allowing a well-positioned midfield horse to grind past them in the soft ground.
scenarios.body: Sudbury Hill, whose recent Goodwood form includes two wins over 10f-17f at the course, would relish a truly gruelling test of stamina, and a horse that sits just off the pace without burning out has a strong chance of picking up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: True Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so strong that it collapses dramatically in the home straight and creates a genuine late window for hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: This is the least likely shape given Echalar, Ohara, and Unchartedterritory are all redistributed from their natural rear positions into midfield, meaning they are unlikely to achieve genuine last-to-first trips; even if they improve into the race, the overcrowded hold-up group and soft ground conspire against a clean late sweep.

watchPoints.text: Gloryous and Itica — watch whether Murphy attempts to dominate or lets Gloryous take the role; if they race hard against each other for the first four furlongs on soft ground, both could tie up and dramatically open the race for Dunkeld Dreamer or Sudbury Hill.

Unchartedterritory ran just 1 day ago — watch market moves and parade ring behaviour closely, as a horse returning this quickly on soft ground could either be a bold handler's move or a sign of distress; treat any price drift as significant.

Itica's stamina for 1m3f is entirely unproven — all her form is at 8f, and if she fades after setting the early pace, she could cause interference or create a bunched finish in the Goodwood straight that disrupts the true closers behind her.

Sudbury Hill — watch his position at the start; his natural style is hold-up but his Goodwood course form is strong, and if Callum Rodriguez can slot him just behind the leaders rather than at the rear of the pack, his stamina profile over the trip gives him a tactical edge.

Dunkeld Dreamer — monitor whether Clifford Lee opts to track Gloryous directly or gives her a few lengths; sitting in the slipstream of a front-runner in soft ground at Goodwood is the optimal position in this race shape and Burke's horses have been running well in this 14-day window.

races.name: City Of Chichester Handicap Stakes (gbbplus Race)

runners_data.name: Synergism
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for Prescott with solid Goodwood course form including a win over 14f here; soft going is fine and the hg:p (hood) suggests he can be keen — getting a clear run in a crowded prominent group will be the challenge.

runners_data.name: Bahadur
runners_data.note: Modest recent form with a string of mid-field finishes in similar company; returns to Goodwood where he did win last time but from OR=91 in a competitive field his consistency is a concern and soft ground has not unlocked his best.

runners_data.name: Blazeon Five
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up horse for Alan King who has won twice from five runs on similar soft ground and has placed at Goodwood over 16f; the 64-day absence is worth noting but this trip and going profile suit him well.
runners_data.comment: Blazeon Five showed smart form when winning back-to-back four and five starts back, and her second two starts back underlines her consistency at this level; the main concern is a 64-day absence returning here off 143 lb.

runners_data.name: Squire Danagher
runners_data.note: Won over 14f at Goodwood on his most recent run and finished second on soft going on his seasonal form-string; 78 days off is the flag here, but Lavelle has had a quiet two weeks and he handles this course and trip combination convincingly.
runners_data.comment: Squire Danagher arrives on the back of three consecutive wins but faces a fitness query after 78 days off, and his speed rating of 71 gives modest cause for optimism; he has experience on today's going, though 141 lb is no trifle.

runners_data.name: Senor Cortez
runners_data.note: Arrives on the back of a hat-trick of wins all at Sandown on good-to-firm type surfaces; the step up to soft ground at Goodwood is a clear question mark despite his excellent recent momentum and strong Loughnane booking.
runners_data.comment: Ranked well adrift of the field on our figures, Senor Cortez faces a stiff ask at the weights on 140 lb, yet his recent form is undeniably eye-catching — three wins in his last three starts — and he has run over today's trip before.

runners_data.name: Moon Over Miami
runners_data.note: Ran well when winning over 16f at Goodwood on his best effort, but his natural prominent style could not be mapped to that position given how many forward-racers are in this field; his soft-going record is modest and racing further back than ideal tempers his prospect.
runners_data.comment: Moon Over Miami shaped well to score five starts back, and his experience over today's trip and going underlines his credentials as a leading threat; the main concern is whether 64 days off the track has left him short of peak sharpness.

runners_data.name: Marnier
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse for Gary & Josh Moore with his best recent form coming at Goodwood — won over 14f and placed twice here; soft going is fine and his consistent finishing profile makes him dangerous if the pace burns up ahead of him.
runners_data.comment: Marnier won two starts back but was only sixth last time out, and while he has run over today's trip and comes here on a workable 22-day break, a weight of 139 lb may test his ability to build on that earlier success.

runners_data.name: Personal Best
runners_data.note: One of two confirmed front-runners who will be instrumental in shaping this race; has won twice over 14f at Goodwood and handles soft, but setting the pace over 2m in this ground against Maxident makes survival to the line a real test.
runners_data.comment: Ranked eighth of nine on our figures, Personal Best faces a stiff ask, though she arrives in decent heart — a winner last time out and placed on two of her four starts before that. She has experience of today's trip and going, and 37 days between runs should leave her fresh.

runners_data.name: Maxident
runners_data.note: The other confirmed pacemaker with an outstanding soft-going record (10 runs with 1 win and 7 places); has placed repeatedly on similar ground and this is his optimal surface, giving him the best chance of the lead pair to sustain his effort.
runners_data.comment: Maxident arrives on the back of two consecutive runner-up finishes and a win three starts back, showing admirable consistency, and our rating of 92 marks him out as a leading danger; the main concern is whether he can finally convert that placed form into victory.

runners_data.name: Premiere Ligne
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse for Hughie Morrison but his recent form is poor — a run of 6-7-6-9-15 in soft-ground events suggests he is finding it hard to land a blow at this level despite the fitting going profile; hg:t noted.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Premiere Ligne nonetheless catches the eye on our rating of 91, and he has run over today's trip and going, arriving here fresh on a 20-day break carrying 129 lb.

runners_data.name: Knight Templar
runners_data.note: Has a good recent record with wins and places at this trip level, but his natural tendency to race prominently could not be accommodated in the mapping given the congested front of the field; racing further back than suits slightly tempers confidence despite his sound course form.
runners_data.comment: Knight Templar shapes as a tough sell, ranked last of the nine on our figures, and he was unplaced last time out after consecutive placed efforts; his sole recent win came six starts back, making him hard to fancy despite experience over today's trip and distance.

races.paceDynamic: Personal Best and Maxident are the two confirmed front-runners in an 11-runner field over 2m on soft ground at Goodwood, and both are likely to press from the outset, creating a genuinely contested lead rather than a soft, uncontested gallop. Soft ground over this trip will amplify the stamina test and make the early fractions genuinely taxing, meaning those who go with the pace risk burning out before the straight. This field contains more prominent-types than the race can accommodate — Synergism, Bahadur, Senor Cortez, and Squire Danagher all want to race in the first three or four, and with Moon Over Miami and Knight Templar pushed back from their natural positions, the front of the race will be crowded early. The tactical verdict is clear: a genuine two-way battle up front on soft ground over 2m at Goodwood strongly favours horses who can settle in midfield or hold up off the pace and pick up the pieces late, particularly those with proven soft-ground stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Lead Burns Rivals
scenarios.trigger: If Personal Best and Maxident fight for the lead and set a taxing pace that strings the field out, draining the prominent horses.
scenarios.body: The soft ground and 2m trip will amplify any overly strong gallop, and prominent chasers like Synergism or Senor Cortez risk emptying in the straight after racing keenly into the pace; genuine hold-up horses and stout stayers able to settle will be delivered late with untapped reserves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Survive Together
scenarios.trigger: If Personal Best and Maxident share the lead at a controlled tempo and both find reserves in the straight.
scenarios.body: A measured soft-ground gallop can play into the hands of the pace-setters themselves, as controlled fractions prevent them from over-extending; Maxident's strong soft-going record and Personal Best's course form make both live contenders under this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Types Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the anticipated pace battle fails to materialise and one front-runner goes clear at a surprisingly sedate tempo, allowing prominent horses to lob in a comfortable position.
scenarios.body: Without genuine pressure from behind, horses like Senor Cortez — who carries a hat-trick of recent wins and natural forward-racing style — or Squire Danagher could take advantage of a false pace and win with something in hand.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Swamp Field Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely fierce early and produces a wall of tired horses for late finishers to navigate in the straight.
scenarios.body: This scenario depends partly on Moon Over Miami and Knight Templar, both naturally prominent types who have been pushed back in the mapping due to the crowded front half of the field — racing genuinely out of role reduces their effectiveness; Blazeon Five and Marnier are the more credible beneficiaries here.

watchPoints.text: Personal Best and Maxident are on a collision course for the lead — watch the first two furlongs to see whether one blinks; if neither concedes the pace will be genuinely fierce and the race will be won from behind.

Senor Cortez arrives on a hat-trick but all three wins came at Sandown on faster ground — if soft conditions blunt his finishing kick he could fade from a prominent position despite his recent confidence.
Squire Danagher is 78 days off the track with a trainer in poor recent form (0 wins from 6 in 14 days); watch for any market drift that signals concerns behind the scenes about his readiness.

Blazeon Five and Marnier are the two most naturally-suited hold-up horses with genuine soft-ground credentials; if the pace is strong early, watch how quickly they move through the field from the home turn as a key race-shape indicator.

Moon Over Miami and Knight Templar — both naturally prominent types forced further back than ideal — are worth tracking on the inner in the early stages; if they push forward and reclaim their natural position the redistribution assessment will need revisiting in running.

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: A Major Payne
runners_data.note: Consistent course performer with two wins at Goodwood over this exact 10f trip, handled soft going on last start, Oisin Murphy booking is significant, hg:p helps, and at OR 86 is well placed in this grade — a natural prominent racer who can realistically hold that position here.|
runners_data.comment: Third last time out and a winner two starts back, A Major Payne brings a consistent recent profile — two wins in his last six starts — and has run over today's trip and going before, though carrying 143 lb from stall 10 makes life no easier for a horse ranked sixth of eleven.

runners_data.name: War Hawk
runners_data.note: Trainer Crisford in good recent form (3/21 T14), but five consecutive Goodwood runs without a win and only one soft-ground win in recent history makes this surface a mild concern at OR 85.|

runners_data.name: Thinthread
runners_data.note: Won at Sandown over 10f on good-to-soft conditions and shows some form at this level, but soft going is unproven in his last two soft outings (5th, 10th), trainer Baker in decent nick (1/7 T14).|
runners_data.comment: Thinthread has managed one win in his last five starts, with an unplaced effort most recently, and ranked ninth of eleven on our figures he looks hard to fancy, though he has run over today's trip before and returns on a reasonable 29-day break.

runners_data.name: Obito
runners_data.note: Won last time out on soft going over 10f which is exactly this trip and surface, genuine hold-up horse who benefits most if the front-runners go fast enough, Daniel Tudhope retains the ride and is a strong positive.|
runners_data.comment: Obito comes here on the back of a win last time out and has experience of today's trip and conditions, making him an appealing pick under 142 lb from stall six, despite a couple of moderate efforts in the runs immediately prior.

runners_data.name: First Ambition
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who will press for the lead alongside Lavender Gold; soft going is fine (3/10 sim-going) but recent form shows mostly modest finishes and no win since rated below this OR, so winning chance depends entirely on controlling tempo.|
runners_data.comment: First Ambition has run over today's trip and going before, and our rating of 93 has him narrowly top-rated — a compelling case on the figures that he has the ability for this. The risk is a winless recent spell across his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Bearish
runners_data.note: Three-year-old with two wins at Goodwood including over 8f, but stepping up significantly to 10f on softest ground yet after finishing 13th on soft at Newbury last time — the soft stamina test is the key unknown.|
runners_data.comment: Bearish won two starts back and was a winner four starts back, giving him a lively recent profile, though he was unplaced last time and carries 137 lb from stall 9; he has run over today's trip and returns on a quick nine-day turnaround.

runners_data.name: Alcaraz
runners_data.note: Seven-year-old who clearly loves soft ground (7 runs, 1 win, 2 placed in sim going), hold-up style suits if the pace is strong, but OR 80 reflects some decline and the question mark run over 16f on handicap marks is a minor concern.|
runners_data.comment: Alcaraz has twice finished second in recent starts and returns after 29 days off with experience of today's trip and going, his rating of 92 giving him a clear edge on official figures; the risk is that he has been winless in his last five starts, with an unplaced effort last time out to overcome.

runners_data.name: Due To Henry
runners_data.note: Strong soft-ground performer (2 wins in sim going from 7 runs), a natural prominent type who is likely to find himself further back than ideal in this pace-heavy field — his chance is undermined by the inability to get his favoured position, making his running style a genuine handicap today.|
runners_data.comment: Due To Henry has been placed twice in his last five starts — third last time out and a second three runs back — but is winless in recent starts and returns after 78 days off, which adds a fitness query; he has run over today's trip and going, and 134 lb from stall four is the weight he must overcome.

runners_data.name: Brigid's Well
runners_data.note: Three-year-old at OR 82 who has not won and has been consistent at best; soft going has seen 0 wins from 2 runs, hg:tp applied, Hugo Palmer's yard in fair 14-day form (3/38) but this looks a tough ask stepping to 10f.|
runners_data.comment: Brigid's Well has experience over today's trip and, rated 92 by us against an official mark of 82, she looks significantly better than her current handicap rating suggests, making her a genuine danger from stall 3; the concern is a winless recent run of five starts.

runners_data.name: Si Grass
runners_data.note: Recent form includes two wins and a placed run on soft going, a naturally prominent-running horse who will likely be shuffled back in this crowded prominent group — racing out of his preferred position reduces his chance materially, though Johnston's yard is in strong form (4/38 T14).|
runners_data.comment: Ranked last on our figures and beaten into fifth last time out, Si Grass faces a stiff ask under 129 lb, with consecutive poor efforts in her two most recent starts making her hard to fancy, though a win four starts back shows she can find the winner's enclosure.

runners_data.name: Lavender Gold
runners_data.note: Won on soft going over 10f earlier this year, confirmed front-runner who will battle First Ambition for the lead, but recent form has deteriorated (10th at Sandown last time) and dropping in OR to 75 suggests a horse needing things to fall right.|
runners_data.comment: Ranked tenth of eleven on our figures, Lavender Gold is hard to fancy despite winning two starts back, as an unplaced effort last time and a modest speed rating of 73 make him difficult to support; he has run over today's trip and going, and returns after a 36-day break.

races.paceDynamic: First Ambition and Lavender Gold are the two confirmed front-runners and will contest the lead from the outset over Goodwood's 1m2f trip on soft ground, creating a genuinely contested early gallop rather than a dawdle. With A Major Payne, War Hawk, Bearish, and Thinthread all pressing for prominent positions, the pace pressure through the first half of the race is real and sustained, which will test stamina on this soft surface. This field holds more front-running and prominent types than can realistically secure their natural positions — Si Grass and Due To Henry are genuine prominent horses who will likely find themselves further back than ideal, with A Major Payne and Bearish best placed to actually hold the prominent berths given their profile and jockey quality. A contested, honest gallop on soft ground at Goodwood over 1m2f classically rewards the horse who travels well in a prominent-to-midfield position and picks up efficiently in the straight — this race shape favours genuine soft-ground stayers with a prominent racing style who aren't burning energy fighting for position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If First Ambition and Lavender Gold battle for the lead and set an honest gallop that stretches the field on the soft ground.
scenarios.body: The sustained early pace burns off the hold-up horses' waiting game and leaves the race to those who have travelled smoothly in the first three or four, finishing off the tiring front-runners in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Outstays Field
scenarios.trigger: If one of the two front-runners — most likely First Ambition — controls the pace at a rhythm that suits them and the soft ground turns this into a stamina slog.
scenarios.body: On soft ground at Goodwood, a front-runner who doesn't over-exert early can steal a winning break as rivals fail to pick up in the testing conditions; First Ambition's course form at 1m2f and pace-control make this plausible.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Arrive Late
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go hard enough early to set up a strong late run for the genuine hold-up horses tracking at the back.
scenarios.body: Obito, who won last time on soft and comes from off the pace, and Alcaraz, with strong soft-ground form, are the natural beneficiaries if the race becomes a true test of stamina and finishing power.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Compressed Midfield Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more moderate than expected and the field concertinas turning in, producing a tight multi-horse finish from midfield.
scenarios.body: Si Grass and Due To Henry, though displaced from their preferred prominent position, could be caught closer to the pace than anticipated and get involved if the gallop is less testing than forecast; this scenario is discounted because both are racing out of role.

watchPoints.text: First Ambition and Lavender Gold will fight for the lead — watch whether either blinks or concedes, because whoever controls the gallop at their own tempo radically changes the race shape for all hold-up horses.

Obito's last-time-out soft-ground win over this exact trip makes him the headline hold-up threat, but he needs the front-runners to genuinely burn each other out — if the pace is moderate his finishing run may not arrive in time.

Si Grass and Due To Henry are both natural prominent types who cannot realistically get their preferred position in this field — watch whether either jockey elects to push forward regardless, which could disrupt the intended pace scenario.
Bearish makes a significant stamina leap to 10f on the softest ground of his career; watch the market for any drift that signals doubt about his ability to see out this trip under these conditions.

A Major Payne has won twice at Goodwood over this trip and Oisin Murphy rarely commits to a prominent position without intent — watch his positioning in the first two furlongs as a key read on whether the pace is genuinely contested or controlled.
